title: Fix assessment chain test regression from Phase 1 gaining passive-lan-iot-discovery step (backlog-133)
goal: Update test_assessment_chain_skips_zero_target_follow_up_steps_without_failing to complete both Phase 1 steps before asserting pending_phase_approval. After the first run completes and the chain starts the passive-lan-iot-discovery run, create and complete a second run for passive-lan-iot-discovery so that Phase 1 finishes and the chain advances to the Phase 2 approval gate. Alternatively, update the test to assert that after step 1 the chain is active (starting step 2), and add an assertion that after step 2 the chain is pending_phase_approval.
scope: api/tests/test_assessment_chain.py::test_assessment_chain_skips_zero_target_follow_up_steps_without_failing fails with 'AssertionError: assert active == pending_phase_approval'. The test creates a run for 'passive-network-discovery' (Phase 1, Step 1 of FULL-INTERNAL-LAN), marks it completed, calls advance_assessment_chain_for_completed_run, and expects the chain to move to pending_phase_approval (Phase 2 requires active-tier approval). But since backlog-133 added 'passive-lan-iot-discovery' as a second step in Phase 1, the chain advances to start Step 2 within Phase 1 rather than completing Phase 1 and requesting Phase 2 approval. The chain status is therefore 'active' (running passive-lan-iot-discovery), not 'pending_phase_approval'.

inputs.root_cause: backlog-133 added passive-lan-iot-discovery as a second profile in Phase 1 of FULL-INTERNAL-LAN. The test was written when Phase 1 had only passive-network-discovery. After completing Step 1, the chain correctly advances to Step 2 (passive-lan-iot-discovery) instead of moving to Phase 2. The test expectation is now stale.
